JOB441 (the wrong shutdown-notice run that had delivered to 1501 U Street last night) was halted and its remaining stock quarantined before the 06:00 run, so the stale-GIS wrong route could not repeat. Keisha Brown approved the exact correction packet: a targeted retraction to 1501 U Street only (wording: the June 12 shutdown notice delivered there was sent in error, the address is not affected, disregard the earlier notice), targeted correction only with no neighborhood-wide send, and the all-Shaw blast draft was not used. JOB442, the corrected manifest, was dispatched from the print yard with the 06:00 run carrying door hangers to exactly those four crew-verified addresses, English throughout with Spanish added for 1400 14th Street using the approved bilingual template outage-C, excluding 1501 U Street, per the comms lead's approval.
